title: Professional GitHub Actions Portfolio knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Professional GitHub Actions Portfolio?
options: A professional portfolio should show the design, code, successful and failed run evidence, security decisions, trade-offs, maintenance plan, and recovery procedure.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
questions.answer_key: A professional portfolio should show the design, code, successful and failed run evidence, security decisions, trade-offs, maintenance plan, and recovery procedure.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of professional github actions portfolio: A professional portfolio should show the design, code, successful and failed run evidence, security decisions, trade-offs, maintenance plan, and recovery procedure. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

questions.prompt: A team is working with “Publishing sample workflow repositories”. Which practice best fits this topic?
options: Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
Make the workflow contract explicit: identify the event, job runner, inputs, command/action, output, and failure signal. Keep steps small and review the permissions and source of every action.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
questions.answer_key: Make the workflow contract explicit: identify the event, job runner, inputs, command/action, output, and failure signal. Keep steps small and review the permissions and source of every action.
questions.explanation: Publishing sample workflow repositories: Make the workflow contract explicit: identify the event, job runner, inputs, command/action, output, and failure signal. Keep steps small and review the permissions and source of every action. Apply the guidance to the actual event, runner, permissions, or artifact boundary and test the relevant case.

questions.prompt: How should a reviewer verify a change related to professional github actions portfolio?
options: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
Retry every failure without looking at the exit code or preserving evidence.
Publish the workflow to production before reviewing its triggers and permissions.
questions.answer_key: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
questions.explanation: Reliable verification uses observable evidence. For this lesson, consider: A professional portfolio should show the design, code, successful and failed run evidence, security decisions, trade-offs, maintenance plan, and recovery procedure. A syntax check alone cannot prove remote execution, permissions, or deployment behavior.
